# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

**Red-CI rework flow (the STANDARD sticky-approval flow!):**
- head H: pr_approved + APPROVE record (blocking 0). Validation red. fail-validation requeues agent:rework on issue.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

{"content":"🚨 **BLOCKING: Reconciliation strips CI-driven `agent:rework` arms and breaks red-CI dead-letter recovery**

`resolveLoserLabel('APPROVE')` unconditionally makes `agent:rework` the loser, and `reconcileDecision` strips it from **both** carriers whenever it is present. But an APPROVE verdict record does **not** invalidate every rework arm — `agent:rework` has non-review sources that legitimately coexist with an APPROVE record on the same head:

1. **Red-CI rework on a sticky-approved PR (the standard flow).** `fail_validation` (smAgent.js ~2845) re-arms `agent:rework` on the linked issue when validation goes red — documented as "pr_approved is STICKY … Validation red post-approval re-arms rework only". That head carries the APPROVE record the review leg just stamped. `reconcile-review-verdicts` is rule #3 — it runs **before** `fail-validation` and before the `rework-on-red-ci` dispatch — so on the very next tick it strips the issue's `agent:rework` and posts a ⚖️ comment saying "suggestions do not justify a rework arm" (factually wrong: it was a red-CI arm).
2. **Dead-letter recovery destroyed.** The issue carrier is sticky *by design*: "the issue arm must survive dispatch so a failed/never-started leg is re-fired (the dead-letter recovery the machine loop is built on)" (rework-on-red-ci description). Once reconcile strips the label ahead of the dispatch rule's query, a dead/never-started rework leg is never re-fired — and `fail-validation` cannot re-arm either (`ai_validating` is already consumed and nothing re-arms validation on a red head). The PR strands red + approved with no leg: the exact deadlock class gh-683/gh-710 fixed.
3. **`conflict-rework` arms** (DIRTY head) are re-added every tick and stripped again by rule #3 → a strip/re-add yo-yo with one ⚖️ comment per tick (the same yo-yo class gh-751 eliminated).
4. **Manual human `agent:rework` labels** (rework-on-label honors them for ANY author) are silently stripped the same way — despite the stated "only machine-owned labels reconcile" guarantee.

The hygiene test asserts `fail-validation` stays `notLatestVerdict`-neutral ("red CI arms rework regardless of which review verdict is newest") — but the reconcile **action** is not verdict-neutral on the arm side, so the invariant only holds at the query layer.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

`resolveLoserLabel('APPROVE')` unconditionally makes `agent:rework` the loser, and `reconcileDecision` strips it from **both** carriers whenever it is present. - **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

{"content":"🚨 **BLOCKING: Reconciliation strips CI-driven `agent:rework` arms and breaks red-CI dead-letter recovery**

`resolveLoserLabel('APPROVE')` unconditionally makes `agent:rework` the loser, and `reconcileDecision` strips it from **both** carriers whenever it is present. But an APPROVE verdict record does **not** invalidate every rework arm — `agent:rework` has non-review sources that legitimately coexist with an APPROVE record on the same head:

1. **Red-CI rework on a sticky-approved PR (the standard flow).** `fail_validation` (smAgent.js ~2845) re-arms `agent:rework` on the linked issue when validation goes red — documented as "pr_approved is STICKY … Validation red post-approval re-arms rework only". That head carries the APPROVE record the review leg just stamped. `reconcile-review-verdicts` is rule #3 — it runs **before** `fail-validation` and before the `rework-on-red-ci` dispatch — so on the very next tick it strips the issue's `agent:rework` and posts a ⚖️ comment saying "suggestions do not justify a rework arm" (factually wrong: it was a red-CI arm).
2. **Dead-letter recovery destroyed.** The issue carrier is sticky *by design*: "the issue arm must survive dispatch so a failed/never-started leg is re-fired (the dead-letter recovery the machine loop is built on)" (rework-on-red-ci description). Once reconcile strips the label ahead of the dispatch rule's query, a dead/never-started rework leg is never re-fired — and `fail-validation` cannot re-arm either (`ai_validating` is already consumed and nothing re-arms validation on a red head). The PR strands red + approved with no leg: the exact deadlock class gh-683/gh-710 fixed.
3. **`conflict-rework` arms** (DIRTY head) are re-added every tick and stripped again by rule #3 → a strip/re-add yo-yo with one ⚖️ comment per tick (the same yo-yo class gh-751 eliminated).
4. **Manual human `agent:rework` labels** (rework-on-label honors them for ANY author) are silently stripped the same way — despite the stated "only machine-owned labels reconcile" guarantee.

The hygiene test asserts `fail-validation` stays `notLatestVerdict`-neutral ("red CI arms rework regardless of which review verdict is newest") — but the reconcile **action** is not verdict-neutral on the arm side, so the invariant only holds at the query layer.

**Suggested fix** (small): in `reconcileReviewVerdicts`, skip stripping `agent:rework` when the head has a real CI failure — the existing `headHasRealFailure(repoInfo, headSha)` probe — or pass an `armIsCiDriven`/`checksRed` fact into `reconcileDecision`'s state. Then add a unit replay: APPROVE record + red checks + issue armed by fail-validation ⇒ arm survives, no comment.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

The hygiene test asserts `fail-validation` stays `notLatestVerdict`-neutral ("red CI arms rework regardless of which review verdict is newest") — but the reconcile **action** is not verdict-neutral on the arm side, so the invariant only holds at the query layer.

{"content":"🚨 **BLOCKING: Reconciliation strips CI-driven `agent:rework` arms and breaks red-CI dead-letter recovery**

`resolveLoserLabel('APPROVE')` unconditionally makes `agent:rework` the loser, and `reconcileDecision` strips it from **both** carriers whenever it is present. But an APPROVE verdict record does **not** invalidate every rework arm — `agent:rework` has non-review sources that legitimately coexist with an APPROVE record on the same head:

1. **Red-CI rework on a sticky-approved PR (the standard flow).** `fail_validation` (smAgent.js ~2845) re-arms `agent:rework` on the linked issue when validation goes red — documented as "pr_approved is STICKY … Validation red post-approval re-arms rework only". That head carries the APPROVE record the review leg just stamped. `reconcile-review-verdicts` is rule #3 — it runs **before** `fail-validation` and before the `rework-on-red-ci` dispatch — so on the very next tick it strips the issue's `agent:rework` and posts a ⚖️ comment saying "suggestions do not justify a rework arm" (factually wrong: it was a red-CI arm).
2. **Dead-letter recovery destroyed.** The issue carrier is sticky *by design*: "the issue arm must survive dispatch so a failed/never-started leg is re-fired (the dead-letter recovery the machine loop is built on)" (rework-on-red-ci description). Once reconcile strips the label ahead of the dispatch rule's query, a dead/never-started rework leg is never re-fired — and `fail-validation` cannot re-arm either (`ai_validating` is already consumed and nothing re-arms validation on a red head). The PR strands red + approved with no leg: the exact deadlock class gh-683/gh-710 fixed.
3. **`conflict-rework` arms** (DIRTY head) are re-added every tick and stripped again by rule #3 → a strip/re-add yo-yo with one ⚖️ comment per tick (the same yo-yo class gh-751 eliminated).
4. **Manual human `agent:rework` labels** (rework-on-label honors them for ANY author) are silently stripped the same way — despite the stated "only machine-owned labels reconcile" guarantee.

The hygiene test asserts `fail-validation` stays `notLatestVerdict`-neutral ("red CI arms rework regardless of which review verdict is newest") — but the reconcile **action** is not verdict-neutral on the arm side, so the invariant only holds at the query layer.

**Suggested fix** (small): in `reconcileReviewVerdicts`, skip stripping `agent:rework` when the head has a real CI failure — the existing `headHasRealFailure(repoInfo, headSha)` probe — or pass an `armIsCiDriven`/`checksRed` fact into `reconcileDecision`'s state. Then add a unit replay: APPROVE record + red checks + issue armed by fail-validation ⇒ arm survives, no comment.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.

Senior Code Reviewer & Security Expert You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,
pr_diff.txt, pr_files.txt, ci_failures.md,

pr_discussions_raw.json"] READ --> DIFF["2. Run diff checklist on pr_diff.txt"] DIFF --> FILES["3. Read full content of every changed file"] FILES --> CODEGRAPH["4. Use CodeGraph:
callers/callees of changed symbols,
search for sensitive patterns,
impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 810
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/pull/810
- **Title**: gh-807 [BUG] Contradictory review verdicts on one head are never reconciled — APPROVE + REQUEST_CHANGES 97s apart left pr_approved and agent:rework coexisting (fa PR #1428)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-807` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +1968
- **Deletions**: -294
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T07:12:05Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T08:04:12Z

## PR Description

Closes #807
### Root Cause

Two review legs concluded on the same PR head 97s apart with contradictory verdicts (fa PR #1428: APPROVE at 05:47:30Z, REQUEST_CHANGES at 05:47:40Z) and both side effects stuck — `pr_approved` + `agent:rework` coexisting. Three composing defects: (a) verdicts were free-form comments with no head association, so head-matching probes can never tie a verdict to a head; (b) the SM tick had no verdict-reconciliation step; (c) the arming side (`arm_rework`) ignored the sticky-approval rule the rework side enforces.

### Fix

- `js/common/reviewVerdicts.js` (new): the verdict-record protocol — structured marker `<!-- dmtools:review-verdict {head, verdict, blocking, important, suggestions, at, source} -->`; newest-wins per head with the AC1 conflict WARN (`⚠️ verdict conflict on <head>: APPROVE vs REQUEST_CHANGES — newest wins`); loser-label resolution; reconciliation comment citing both verdict sources; the arming gate. Pure module, fully unit-tested.
- `js/postPRReviewComments.js`: the review leg stamps the machine-parseable record on the PR (head sha required — no head-less verdicts; records what the leg actually did after approve-with-suggestions overrides). Non-fatal, both anchored and PR-anchored paths.
- `js/smAgent.js`: new `reconcile_verdicts` localAction — removes the loser label from BOTH carriers (PR + linked issue) with one comment citing both verdict sources (AC2); `arm_rework` now withholds the arm when the effective verdict is APPROVE with zero BLOCKING findings — suggestions never trigger rework (AC3). Both fail open for pre-gh-807 PRs without records.
- `js/sm/sources/githubSource.js` + `js/common/smProvider.js`: `latestVerdict` / `notLatestVerdict` query guards over the newest record for the current head (ioCache-memoized, fail-open); verdict-guard rules now fetch prStatus (the guards need the head sha).
- `sm_github.json`: new `reconcile-review-verdicts` rule (localAction `reconcile_verdicts`) placed after the rerun twins and before the merge window (#682/#637 invariants untouched); `notLatestVerdict: [REQUEST_CHANGES, BLOCK]` on merge-validated, validate-armed, revalidate-armed, revalidate-armed-green — a newest REQUEST_CHANGES blocks `pr_approved`-gated paths until re-review. Human review state / ruleset approvals untouched.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_reviewVerdicts.js` (new, 20 tests): marker protocol (AC4 — free-form verdict text is invisible), #1428 replay with the exact AC1 WARN, AC2 reconciliation both directions, AC3 arm gate incl. the blocking-thread exception and fail-opens.
- `test_smAgent.js` (+17): #1428 reconciliation replay, both-carriers removal, converged/no-record/text-only no-ops, arm gate (withheld / blocking-exception / changes-requested / legacy), rule hygiene (placement + `notLatestVerdict` lanes).
- `test_smGithubSource.js` (+5), `test_smProvider.js` (+5), `test_postPRReviewComments.js` (+5): guard semantics + needsStatus wiring, provider memoization/fail-open, record posting.
- RED verified: with pre-fix code the #1428 replay and the arming-gate tests fail (arm still fires, no reconciliation); GREEN: full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2019 passed, 0 failed (baseline 1974).

### Notes

- Fail-open everywhere: PRs without verdict records (pre-gh-807) reconcile nothing and arm as before — no behavior change for legacy PRs.
- Only machine-owned labels reconcile; ruleset approvals and human review comments are never touched (clean rollback).
- GitLab gets the guards as inert (no MR-note reader in the tool catalog yet) — documented gap in `smProvider.js`; reconciliation is GitHub-machine-loop behavior for now.
- Live L3 (one review cycle with injected contradictory verdicts on a scratch PR) is pending — needs the next fa tick run against a real deployment.
